title: Materials Test XGF(2) + interactive PBR effects panel
description: Loads the bundled MaterialsTest model as XGF v2 — the PBR/texture/normals/UVs-carrying form produced by the right-click context menu's "Export XGF(2)" action. The same effects panel as the HousePlan / Sponza demos exposes IBL, shadows, SAO, tonemap, bloom, AA, edges, and sun direction so you can stress every renderer pass against the materials suite.
